_notes.usage: Copy this file to config.json and fill in real values. config.json is gitignored-by-convention and should never be committed (it holds credentials).
_notes.rtsp.mode: 'genetec' (default) pulls the feed through a Genetec media-gateway endpoint keyed by camera GUID, using the server/port/username/password below. 'direct' connects straight to the camera's own RTSP server via IP + credentials (see rtsp.direct). Override per camera in cameras.json with 'rtsp_mode'.
_notes.rtsp.direct.url_template: Default is Bosch-style (FLEXIDOME 3000i/5000i etc.): rtsp://user:pass@ip:554/video1 for the main stream, /video2 for the substream, /video3 if trip-streaming is enabled -- no NVR channel prefix, since these are single-sensor domes. Confirm on your specific unit's web UI under RTSP/streaming settings if plates don't OCR from the direct path.
_notes.rtsp.stream: Always the camera's primary/main stream (full resolution) -- OCR needs the detail a substream throws away. Per-camera override via cameras.json 'stream'.
_notes.alpr.expected_frame_width/height: Set to your camera's real sensor resolution (e.g. a 5MP camera is commonly 2592x1944) to catch the RTSP URL accidentally pointing at a low-res substream. Leave both null to disable the check.
_notes.logging.level: DEBUG for troubleshooting (verbose: per-box detection reasons, OCR fragments dropped below min_ocr_conf, RTSP URL/mode chosen). INFO for normal operation.
_notes.event_filter: Trigger events carry a VCA classification per detected object, e.g. Data.Object.Object.Appearance.Class.Type = {"#text": "Vehicle", "@Likelihood": 0.91}. Only events with a detection matching one of class_types (case-insensitive) at or above min_likelihood are queued for ALPR -- everything else (Person/Bicycle detections, low-confidence hits, events with no classified object) is discarded before opening an RTSP stream. Tune min_likelihood against the values your camera actually reports (0.91 in the sample payload this was built from).
